races.name: Free Race Evening Thursday 18th June Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Vocito
runners_data.note: Lead style benefits from 9-day race fitness advantage and carries only 2lb higher than his sole chase success
runners_data.comment: Returns to fences following a convincing win over hurdles at Uttoxeter nine days ago.
runners_data.spotlight: Returns to fences following a convincing win over hurdles at Uttoxeter (2m, good) nine days ago; only 2lb higher than when landing his sole success in this sphere (in November 2024) and must be considered while in winning mode.

runners_data.name: Seaview Rock
runners_data.note: Prominent runner ideally placed behind the pace battle with lightly-raced profile and strong Leicester hurdle win
runners_data.comment: Made a pleasing start over fences when runner-up at this track last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced, he opened his account when winning a maiden hurdle at Leicester (1m7f, heavy) in January; made a pleasing start over fences when runner-up at this track (2m4f, good) last month on his handicap debut, before leaving Olly Murphy for £30,000; drops back in trip without the hood worn previously and has potential to improve over fences.

runners_data.name: Pep Talking
runners_data.note: Bold front-runner whose preference for further than 2m could prove costly in a sustained gallop over this shorter trip
runners_data.comment: Won at Chepstow in April; ran well again when runner-up at Huntingdon last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Bold-jumping front-runner with seven wins from 18 starts over fences; ideally served by further than 2m but won over this trip at Chepstow (good to soft) in April; ran well again when runner-up at Huntingdon (2m4f, good) last month and will be the one to catch.

runners_data.name: Duke Of Luckley
runners_data.note: Leading runner handicapped by 223-day layoff despite strong 2m course record with apprentice jockey claiming valuable 5lb
runners_data.comment: Four of his six wins have been at this track, three over 2m, but has lost his way.
runners_data.spotlight: Four of his six wins have been at this track, three of which over 2m; has lost his way, however, since the last of those in May last year off 7lb higher; well handicapped if he can return to form after absence of 223 days.

runners_data.name: My Friend Sean
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose 0-5 chase record and 71-day absence make him hard to recommend despite favorable tactical position
runners_data.comment: 0-5 over fences and finished last of six at Kempton in March.
runners_data.spotlight: All five wins have been over hurdles; 0-5 over fences and finished last of six at Kempton (2m2f, good) in March; others preferred.

races.paceDynamic: Vocito, Pep Talking and Duke Of Luckley will ensure a fierce gallop from the outset, with all three natural front-runners likely to engage early. This creates a sustained strong pace that will test stamina reserves over the final 3-4 furlongs, particularly as Pep Talking is a bold-jumping front-runner who prefers further than 2m. The relentless gallop will stretch the field and expose any fitness doubts, especially for Duke Of Luckley returning after 223 days off. This race shape strongly favours horses with proven stamina and tactical speed who can position handy but avoid the early burn-up.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the three confirmed pace-setters engage in a speed duel through the first mile
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will expose fitness concerns and stamina limitations, allowing a horse positioned in second rank to strike late. Seaview Rock's prominent style and lightly-raced profile makes him ideally placed to capitalize when the leaders falter.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Vocito Sustains Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Vocito can use his recent race fitness to control the tempo without getting into a speed battle
scenarios.body: His 9-day turnaround from a convincing hurdle win gives him the fitness edge over his pace rivals, allowing him to dictate terms. The returning Duke Of Luckley and stamina-stretched Pep Talking cannot match his current sharpness.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners burn each other out in a sustained speed battle
scenarios.body: My Friend Sean can use his hold-up style to avoid the early carnage and pick up the pieces, though his poor chase record remains a major concern. The collapse of all three pace-setters would create the perfect scenario for a closer.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Duke Returns To Form
scenarios.trigger: If Duke Of Luckley's 223-day absence hasn't dulled his effectiveness and his course record proves decisive
scenarios.body: His four course wins including three over this trip could override fitness concerns if the pace is moderate enough. However, his long absence and poor recent form make this scenario unlikely despite his proven track affinity.

watchPoints.text: Duke Of Luckley's jumping early on after 223 days off and whether he can match the pace set by fresher rivals
Pep Talking's stamina reserves in the final 3 furlongs as his preference for longer trips could be exposed over 2m
The pace battle between all three front-runners and whether any can sustain their effort to the line
Seaview Rock's position turning for home and whether he can capitalize on any pace collapse ahead of him
My Friend Sean's jumping throughout given his poor 0-5 chase record and long recent absence

races.name: Book The Bistro In Seasons Restaurant Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)

runners_data.name: Ceolwulf
runners_data.note: Front-running style perfectly suits this weak pace scenario, 63 days off but proven fresh and handles good ground well.
runners_data.comment: Landed his second win over fences, at Newcastle in March, after finishing runner-up twice.
runners_data.spotlight: Landed his second win over fences when prevailing at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) in March, after finishing runner-up twice; a 4lb rise is workable and he should be thereabouts.

runners_data.name: Henry Box Brown
runners_data.note: Hold-up style needs strong pace to be effective, down to career-low mark but Ellis Collier's 5lb claim is valuable.
runners_data.comment: Last win came in December 2024; hasn't been firing on all cylinders recently.
runners_data.spotlight: Last win came in December 2024 off 6lb higher; hasn't been firing on all cylinders recently but is down to a career-low mark and cannot dismiss.

runners_data.name: Maggies Boy
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with two recent pull-ups raising serious jumping concerns, needs to prove he can complete.
runners_data.comment: Made a winning start over fences at Sedgefield in April but has failed to complete since.
runners_data.spotlight: Made a winning start over fences at Sedgefield (2m5f, good) in April but has failed to complete twice since; needs to get back on track.

runners_data.name: Traveling Soldier
runners_data.note: Prominent runner trying first-time visor after two pull-ups, Sean Bowen booking suggests stable confidence returning.
runners_data.spotlight: Sole success over fences came at Market Rasen (2m1f, soft) last July off this mark; has been pulled up on his last two starts and a first-time visor replaces tongue-tie and cheekpieces; could have a say if the new headgear works.

runners_data.name: Crackerjack Queen
runners_data.note: Prominent style on chase debut with tongue-tie added, modest hurdle form needs significant improvement.
runners_data.comment: Has shown only modest form over hurdles; chase debut and needs to show improvement.
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown only modest form over hurdles; makes chase debut and needs to show improvement.

runners_data.name: Mr Mahler
runners_data.note: Prominent runner on career-low mark after 17 days, 0-16 record but twice placed over fences shows some ability.
runners_data.comment: 0-16 under rules but has runner-up twice over fences; not out of this.
runners_data.spotlight: 0-16 under rules but has runner-up twice over fences; may be sharper following a reappearance over hurdles at Bangor last month and is now on a career-low mark; not out of this.

races.paceDynamic: Ceolwulf will set a steady gallop from the front with no serious pace pressure in this small field. Henry Box Brown, Maggies Boy and Mr Mahler are all hold-up horses who will need the race to develop, while Traveling Soldier and Crackerjack Queen may sit prominent but neither looks keen to force the issue early. The lack of genuine pace-forcing will create a tactical affair with plenty left for the closing stages. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can dictate terms without pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Ceolwulf Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Ceolwulf jumps cleanly and maintains his rhythm from the front.
scenarios.body: The 10-year-old gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear when the pace lifts, making full use of his stamina advantage. Hold-up horses find themselves with too much to do as the lack of early pace leaves them stranded.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If Henry Box Brown or Maggies Boy time their challenge perfectly from the back.
scenarios.body: Despite the modest early pace, the class horses produce strong late kicks to reel in the leader up the hill. Henry Box Brown's proven ability at this level or Maggies Boy's chasing talent shines through.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Traveling Soldier bounces back to form or Crackerjack Queen shows unexpected chasing ability.
scenarios.body: The visor helps Traveling Soldier focus better and he uses his prominent position to strike late, or the chase debutant Crackerjack Queen benefits from the tactical nature. They get first run on the leader while hold-up horses are caught flat-footed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Non-Completions
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses fail to complete or fall at crucial stages.
scenarios.body: The recent poor jumping records of Maggies Boy and Traveling Soldier resurface, leaving a depleted field for the stayers. This opens the door for the most reliable jumper or longest-priced survivor to claim victory.

watchPoints.text: Maggies Boy and Traveling Soldier both have recent pull-up form and their jumping reliability is highly questionable.
Henry Box Brown needs a strong pace to be effective but this race lacks natural pace-forcers beyond Ceolwulf.
Crackerjack Queen makes her chasing debut with tongue-tie fitted, watch how she handles the bigger obstacles early.
Ceolwulf has been off for 63 days and needs to handle the step up to good ground from his recent soft ground success.
Mr Mahler drops to a career-low mark and the McMenamin booking suggests connections fancy an improved effort.

races.name: Ladies Day Sunday 16th August Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Lairig Mor
runners_data.note: Unraced hold-up type from a yard struggling for winners but breeding suggests middle-distance potential over this trip.
runners_data.comment: Hood is worn for this debut and yard not averse to finding winners in this sphere.
runners_data.spotlight: Second foal; dam bumper and 2m1f/2m4f hurdle winner, half-sister to winners Portrade (useful 2m-2m3f hurdle), Kind Heart (1m/1m2f Flat; 2m hurdle), Geronimo Chief and Mardi (both 1m 2yo), out of French 9.5f winner; hood is worn for this debut and yard not averse to finding winners in this sphere; any market move should be noted.

runners_data.name: Moi Mon Vieux
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with French form that's hard to assess but trainer had a recent bumper winner showing yard in form.
runners_data.comment: Has run in a couple of similar contests in France, runner-up on the first occasion.
runners_data.spotlight: Has run in a couple of similar contests over 1m4f in France, runner-up on the first occasion; difficult to assess that form but yard had a bumper winner last month; sports first-time tongue-tie and not out of this.

runners_data.name: Guerdale
runners_data.note: Another lightly-raced unknown quantity whose dam was a staying type, though trainer's 0/3 record over 14 days is concerning.
runners_data.comment: Unlikely to see the best of her until she steps up in trip over hurdles.
runners_data.spotlight: Fourth foal; dam bumper/3m1f hurdle winner, half-sister to bumper and 2m6f-3m2f hurdle/chase winner Georgian King, out of unraced sister to 2m6f hurdle winner Loch Nevis; has a pedigree laden with stamina and unlikely to see the best of her until she steps up in trip over hurdles.

runners_data.name: For Her Glory
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner carrying 7lb penalty but showed real class winning here last month and has tactical advantage.
runners_data.comment: Looked a decent prospect when making a winning debut over C&D last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Looked a decent prospect when making a winning debut over C&D (good) last month; shoulders a 7lb penalty but should be hard to beat.

runners_data.name: Muscadet
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning after 40-day break who should improve from debut fourth but may be better suited to hurdling.
runners_data.comment: May well show improvement following his debut when fourth at Warwick in April.
runners_data.spotlight: May well show improvement following his debut when fourth of eight at Warwick (2m, good) in April but should come into his own when he tackles hurdles.

runners_data.name: Silk Mountain
runners_data.note: Previously showed promise as prominent runner but 85 days off following disappointing effort raises fitness questions.
runners_data.comment: Below the level of his debut fourth when last of seven at Plumpton in March.
runners_data.spotlight: Showed some promise when fourth in AW bumper at Lingfield (2m) on his debut in December, but below that level when last of seven at Plumpton (2m2f, good to soft) in March; hard to fancy.

races.paceDynamic: For Her Glory will take this race by the scruff of the neck from the outset, with no other confirmed front runners to challenge her early supremacy. The prominence-racing trio of Moi Mon Vieux, Muscadet and Silk Mountain will settle behind her but none have shown the tactical speed to pressure the leader meaningfully. This creates a dream scenario for For Her Glory to dictate terms at her own rhythm, building what could become an unassailable advantage turning for home. This pace shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers, as the lack of pace pressure allows them to conserve energy for a decisive move.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: For Her Glory Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If For Her Glory translates her C&D victory into controlled front-running tactics
scenarios.body: She dictates reasonable fractions unchallenged and has enough in reserve to repel late challengers, with her 7lb penalty proving manageable. The prominent racers struggle to close the gap she builds turning for home.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent racers can stay closer to For Her Glory than expected and mount a sustained challenge
scenarios.body: Moi Mon Vieux or Muscadet time their run perfectly as For Her Glory begins to feel the penalty weight in the final furlong. The lack of early pace pressure means they have energy left for a telling strike.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If either Lairig Mor or Guerdale possess hidden class befitting their breeding
scenarios.body: One of the lightly-raced horses produces a performance well above expectations, using the steady early pace to get into contention before showing a turn of foot. Their freshness and potential trump the more exposed rivals.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Silk Mountain Revival
scenarios.trigger: If Silk Mountain can overcome his disappointing Plumpton effort and recapture debut promise
scenarios.body: His 85-day break proves beneficial and he uses the undemanding early pace to position himself perfectly for a late surge. His previous fourth at Lingfield suggests latent ability that could surface here.

watchPoints.text: For Her Glory's penalty weight could tell in the final furlong if the pace becomes more searching than expected.
Moi Mon Vieux's French form is completely untested in British conditions and hard to evaluate accurately.
Both Lairig Mor and Guerdale are stepping into the unknown with minimal exposed form to assess.
Muscadet's 40-day absence could leave him short of peak fitness despite his trainer's good strike rate.
Silk Mountain's 85-day break is the longest of any runner and may indicate underlying issues.

races.name: Summer Fun At Southwell Racecourse "National Hunt" Maiden Hurdle (Nov' Brush Hdl Qualifier) (GBB)

runners_data.name: Katarcice
runners_data.note: Leading style with solid recent hurdles form but may face pressure from Way Maker early which could compromise his finishing kick
runners_data.comment: Twice runner-up at Huntingdon, in a match on latter occasion; he must enter calculations
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up on his hurdling debut at Huntingdon (2m) in April before edged out late in a match there (2m4f) last month; he must enter calculations.

runners_data.name: Kingofthefrontier
runners_data.note: Hold-up style perfectly suits the likely strong pace and his pointing background suggests this longer trip will play to his strengths
runners_data.comment: Winning pointer; shaped well when third at Uttoxeter on hurdling debut; player up in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Winning pointer who shaped well on his hurdling debut under a patient ride when a running-on third of seven in 2m novice at Uttoxeter last month; this longer trip looks a plus for this son of Frontiersman so he's a player.

runners_data.name: Hawk's Rock
runners_data.note: Prominent runner wearing cheekpieces again after recent frame finishes but 10 days since last run keeps him sharp
runners_data.comment: In the frame in a pair of maiden hurdles at Downpatrick and Cartmel; holds solid claims
runners_data.spotlight: Fair form shown in bumpers and (in cheekpieces) when in the frame in a pair of maiden hurdles (around 2m6f) at Downpatrick and Cartmel last month; holds solid claims.

runners_data.name: Way Maker
runners_data.note: Natural leader whose trainer Mickey Bowen shows good recent form at 6/24 and the Perth third suggests improvement to come
runners_data.comment: Dual bumper scorer; promising hurdles debut third at Perth; merits serious consideration
runners_data.spotlight: A dual bumper scorer who made a promising start over hurdles when third of 13 in 2m novice at Perth 19 days ago, nearest finish; this son of Walk In The Park is open to improvement over this longer trip and merits serious consideration.

runners_data.name: Boom Boom Boris
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making hurdling debut after 590-day absence which is a significant concern despite point-to-point placing
runners_data.comment: Last in bumper at Sedgefield 19 months ago; placed in a couple of Irish points last spring
runners_data.spotlight: Last of ten in bumper at Sedgefield for Mike Sowersby 19 months ago; placed in a couple of points last spring and fell early in a point in March; hurdling debutant.

runners_data.name: The Hostage
runners_data.note: Prominent style but poor recent form including last of eight on hurdling debut 17 days ago makes him hard to fancy
runners_data.comment: Last of eight in novice at Uttoxeter on hurdling debut; significantly more is required
runners_data.spotlight: Offered little in a pair of bumpers before coming in last of eight in novice at Uttoxeter (2m4f) on his hurdling debut 17 days ago; significantly more is required.

races.paceDynamic: Katarcice and Way Maker will engage early as the confirmed front runners, with both having natural leading tendencies and recent form suggesting they'll contest the pace from the start. The honest gallop they create over this extended 2m4½f trip should suit horses who can travel well in behind and produce a sustained finish. With only six runners and two keen pace-setters, this sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses to get a strong tempo to aim at. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can benefit from the strong early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If Katarcice and Way Maker duel too hard early and tire in the final half-mile
scenarios.body: The sustained pace over the extended trip will find out the early leaders, allowing closers to sweep past in the final furlong. Kingofthefrontier and Boom Boom Boris benefit most from patient rides and a strong gallop to close into.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Katarcice Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Katarcice can settle into a rhythm after asserting early and maintain his gallop
scenarios.body: His superior OR of 114 and recent hurdles form gives him the class edge when allowed to dictate on his own terms. The son's stamina reserves should prove decisive in a race run to suit his front-running style.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Kingofthefrontier Powers Home
scenarios.trigger: If the ex-pointer can reproduce his Uttoxeter third with improved fitness and the longer trip playing to his strengths
scenarios.body: His patient riding style perfectly suits a race where the front pair set strong fractions, and pointing background suggests he'll relish the extended distance. The hold-up tactics that worked at Uttoxeter become even more potent here.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Way Maker Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If the Perth third can step forward significantly and outbattle Katarcice for the lead
scenarios.body: His trainer Mickey Bowen's 6/24 recent record suggests this horse is primed for improvement from his promising hurdles debut. The dual bumper winner has untapped potential that could surface with natural progression.

watchPoints.text: Boom Boom Boris returning after 590 days off - massive fitness question for a hurdling debutant
Way Maker and Katarcice early pace battle - if they go too hard it opens the door for closers
Kingofthefrontier's jumping on only his second hurdles start - any mistakes will compromise his hold-up tactics
Hawk's Rock in cheekpieces again - watch for any signs of hanging or reluctance that the headgear is meant to address
The Hostage with Sean Bowen taking the ride despite poor recent form - any market confidence would be significant

races.name: Makers Market Mon 27th July Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Jager Time
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with proven stamina who benefits from strong pace and will appreciate the step back up to 3m+
runners_data.comment: Scored over hurdles at Huntingdon in November; fourth at Fontwell last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Opened account over hurdles in 16-runner handicap at Huntingdon (3m1f, good) in November, his eighth attempt; will be all the better for his first run since when fourth of ten at Fontwell (2m5f, good) last month; should run well.

runners_data.name: Innisfree Lass
runners_data.note: Non-runner, removing the key pace angle from this contest
runners_data.comment: All three wins have been over C&D while her other run here resulted in a neck second.
runners_data.spotlight: All three wins have been over C&D while her other run here resulted in a neck second; she was unable to back up her Southwell form when last of five finishers at Fontwell in March; has since left Stuart Edmunds for 2,400gns and remains a formidable opponent around here.

runners_data.name: Jafimgoso
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with recent Ludlow win showing improved form over longer trips
runners_data.comment: Bumper winner who got off the mark in this sphere at Ludlow last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner who had disappointed over hurdles until a step back up in trip brought about the necessary improvement to get off the mark in this sphere at Ludlow (2m5f, good) last month; should be suited by this further step up to 3m and is a leading player.

runners_data.name: Butchers Bill
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but poor overall record (0-12) makes him hard to trust despite light weight
runners_data.comment: Ex-Irish maiden whose overall record is now 0-12; opposable.
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden whose overall record is now 0-12 and he's not finished closer than 10l to a winner; opposable.

runners_data.name: Jefe Triunfo
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse dropping to career-low mark but generally disappointing in handicaps
runners_data.comment: Generally disappointing in handicaps since winning 2m maiden a year ago.
runners_data.spotlight: Generally disappointing in handicaps since winning 2m maiden a year ago and steps up in trip off a career-low mark; worth a look in the betting.

runners_data.name: Larkfield Lusive
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent course record who should improve for recent return run
runners_data.comment: Should strip fitter for his first run for nine months when third at Kelso last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Recorded back-to-back wins at Perth (2m4f) and Market Rasen (2m7f) last summer; should strip fitter for his first run after nearly nine months off when third at Kelso (2m5f, good) last month and holds claims.

runners_data.name: Belladinotte
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with course-and-distance win who may bounce back from poor Hexham effort
runners_data.comment: Doubled her tally when successful over C&D in April; last of 15 at Hexham since.
runners_data.spotlight: Doubled her tally when successful over C&D (good) in April; always behind when last of 15 at Hexham since but may bounce back at her favourite track.

runners_data.name: Boston Savr
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse but tendency to fade late makes him vulnerable over this extended trip
runners_data.comment: Has shown little in four runs over hurdles, latest when beaten 56l at Newbury in February.
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown little in four runs over hurdles, latest when beaten 56l on handicap debut at Newbury (2m4f, good to soft) in February in first-time cheekpieces (replaced by first-time blinkers here); still has time on his side and steps up in trip but needs to show more.

runners_data.name: Mythical
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse but bottom weight reflects poor recent hurdles form including multiple pull-ups
runners_data.comment: Was smart on the Flat but has been pulled up on both starts for this yard over hurdles.
runners_data.spotlight: Smart on the Flat in his prime but has been pulled up on both starts for this yard over hurdles; hard to fancy.

races.paceDynamic: Innisfree Lass is listed as a non-runner, removing the sole confirmed front-runner and creating a pace vacuum. Larkfield Lusive and Butchers Bill will likely fill the void as prominent runners, but neither is a natural pace-forcer, suggesting a moderate tempo early. The 3m½f trip allows hold-up horses like Jafimgoso, Jager Time, and Jefe Triunfo to position off the pace before making their challenges. This moderate pace scenario strongly favours hold-up horses who can use their finishing kick over this stamina-testing distance.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains moderate with no genuine pace pressure
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine early speed allows closers to position perfectly and unleash decisive kicks in the final half-mile. Jafimgoso and Jager Time can exploit their proven finishing ability over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Control
scenarios.trigger: If Larkfield Lusive and Butchers Bill set a steady but consistent gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The honest pace gives prominent runners first run on their rivals, making it difficult for hold-up horses to close the gap. Larkfield Lusive's course-and-distance experience becomes crucial.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the field goes very slowly early and it becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a bunched field turning in, leading to traffic problems and a frantic final furlong. The best turn of foot wins rather than stamina.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Strong Early Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If inexperienced pace-setters go too fast trying to fill the pace void
scenarios.body: The overly strong early pace sets up a perfect scenario for deep closers who can pick up the pieces. Jager Time's stamina and Belladinotte's course form become decisive factors.

watchPoints.text: Jafimgoso could exploit the pace collapse if prominent runners fail to maintain honest gallop
Larkfield Lusive's early positioning crucial given his course advantage and recent fitness concerns
Jager Time needs the pace to develop properly to showcase his proven stamina over this trip
Belladinotte's jumping performance early will indicate whether she's recapturing her course-winning form
The pace-setting duties fall to inexperienced leaders who may misjudge the early fractions

races.name: Enhance Your Race Day With Sponsorship Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Captain Cool
runners_data.note: Front-runner with quick seven-day turnaround after winning over fences, drops 5lbs back to hurdles where he's proven reliable
runners_data.comment: Went 2-2 over fences at Plumpton week ago; back hurdling off 5lb lower mark so a player
runners_data.spotlight: A fair and reliable winning hurdler who advanced his form when going 2-2 over fences in 2m1f Plumpton handicap a week ago; reverts to hurdles off a 5lb lower mark here so merits serious consideration.

runners_data.name: Harel Du Marais
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning to hurdles after disappointing chase efforts, needs pace development to be effective from the rear
runners_data.comment: Scored over fences at Stratford but below par both runs since; more needed back hurdling
runners_data.spotlight: Resumed winning ways over fences at Stratford (2m1f) in March but below par both runs since, beating just one in 2m4f Warwick handicap chase last month; needs to take a big step forward back in this sphere.

runners_data.name: Scottish Anthem
runners_data.note: Hold-up type making handicap debut for new trainer Stuart Edmunds after 40-day break, showed promise last time at Warwick
runners_data.comment: Encouraging stable debut when fifth at Warwick; can take a step forward on h'cap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Fairly useful on the Flat; lightly raced in this sphere and made an encouraging start for his new stable after eight months off when fifth of ten in 2m3f Warwick novice 40 days ago; can take a step forward on his handicap debut with cheekpieces added.

runners_data.name: Squeezebox
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 228-day absence but has strong 2-3 hurdling record, moves into handicaps off a break
runners_data.spotlight: A fair 1m4f Flat scorer who has made a bright start over hurdles, going 2-3 in 2m Fakenham novice when last seen out in October; goes handicapping after an absence now and can't be ruled out.

runners_data.name: Pahlavi
runners_data.note: Prominent performer carrying 5lb claiming rider, struggled in recent chase attempts but has hurdle win at Downpatrick
runners_data.comment: Well below par over fences last two runs; needs return to hurdling to spark resurgence
runners_data.spotlight: Finally got off the mark over hurdles at Downpatrick (2m2f) last May; tried chasing again last month but well below par in handicaps (up to 2m2f) at Wexford and Limerick; needs this return to hurdling to spark a resurgence.

races.paceDynamic: Captain Cool will set the early pace as the sole confirmed front-runner, likely getting an uncontested lead in this small field of five. With Squeezebox and Pahlavi adopting prominent positions behind him, the tempo should be sustainable rather than searching. Both Harel Du Marais and Scottish Anthem are hold-up performers who will need the pace to develop properly from the back. This race shape strongly favours the pace-setters and prominent runners who can position close to Captain Cool's uncontested gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Captain Cool gets an easy lead without pressure from the prominent runners
scenarios.body: The reliable front-runner can dictate terms and has the class to sustain his kick, having won twice recently including over fences just seven days ago. His opponents will struggle to peg back a horse in this form who gets first run.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Squeezebox or Pahlavi press Captain Cool and force a stronger pace
scenarios.body: The pace pressure exposes Captain Cool's quick turnaround from last week, allowing the prominent runners to capitalize with their tactical positioning. Squeezebox has the strongest hurdling form despite his absence.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too conservative and the field bunches up
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace allows Harel Du Marais or Scottish Anthem to mount late challenges from their hold-up positions. Scottish Anthem showed promise last time for new connections despite the layoff.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Captain Cool stops quickly and the prominent runners fade after pressing
scenarios.body: The combination of pressure on the leader and tactical errors from prominent runners creates chaos in the final furlong. This opens the door for any horse with late kick regardless of early position.

watchPoints.text: Captain Cool's quick turnaround from last week's chase win could catch up with him if pressed for pace early
Squeezebox returning from 228-day layoff in handicap company for the first time after novice success
Scottish Anthem making handicap debut with limited hurdle experience against seasoned handicappers
Pahlavi using 5lb claim from Paddy Hanlon which could prove decisive in tight finish
Both hold-up horses need genuine pace to be effective but may struggle if Captain Cool gets soft lead

races.name: Southwell Racecourse Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: This Sway
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with good recent form who should get an easy lead in this small field
runners_data.comment: Good second at Ffos Las latest; up 2lb but form franked so he must enter calculations
runners_data.spotlight: Gained a first win over 2m here in March and has continued in good form, runner-up in 2m4f Ffos Las handicap four weeks ago; that form has been well advertised since so he must enter calculations despite 2lb rise.

runners_data.name: Klervia
runners_data.note: Prominent style but poor recent form and wind operation suggests she may struggle to keep up
runners_data.comment: Winless and below-par fifth in Huntingdon handicap two weeks ago; others are preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Remains winless and she underwent wind surgery before a below-par fifth of eight in 2m Huntingdon handicap two weeks ago; others are preferred.

runners_data.name: Tiggerelli
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making stable debut after long 91-day break which raises fitness concerns
runners_data.comment: Well held in bumpers; fared little better in four hurdling runs for Paul Robson
runners_data.spotlight: Well held in a trio of bumpers for Sandy Thomson and she fared little better in four hurdling runs for Paul Robson; starts out for another new yard here with lots to prove.

runners_data.name: Ghost Jury
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 224-day absence but recent point-to-point win shows retained ability
runners_data.comment: Remote fourth at Exeter in October; in winning form in points since so not ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: 0-10 and came in a remote fourth of five in 2m2f handicap hurdle at Exeter in October; in winning form in points last month though so she's not totally out of things.

runners_data.name: Beorma
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with Harry Skelton up and fresh from impressive chasing debut just 5 days ago
runners_data.spotlight: Little show in a handful of runs over hurdles; tongue tied and took a major step forward though when impressively landing 2m Worcester handicap on her chasing debut five days ago; reverts to hurdling off the same mark and holds leading claims with headgear retained.

runners_data.name: Inca
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with modest form who needs significant improvement to feature prominently
runners_data.comment: Fair fourth of eight in 2m7f handicap at Uttoxeter last month; needs to build on it
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in an Irish point but only modest form shown in this sphere, finishing fourth of eight in 2m7f handicap at Uttoxeter last month; needs to build on it.

races.paceDynamic: This Sway will lead from the start with his prominent style, likely joined by fellow prominent runners Klervia and Beorma in the early stages. With only one confirmed front runner in a small field, This Sway should get his own way in front, setting a steady gallop that won't stretch the field early. The hold-up horses Tiggerelli, Ghost Jury and Inca will need to rely on the pace quickening enough from three out to showcase their finishing kicks. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours the prominent runners who can track the leader and have first run on the hold-up horses when the tempo lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Suits Prominents
scenarios.trigger: If This Sway leads unchallenged and sets an undemanding gallop to three out
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get ideal positioning to strike first when the pace lifts, leaving insufficient time for hold-up horses to make ground. This Sway and Beorma benefit from tactical positioning and sustainable pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Klervia and Beorma press This Sway early creating genuine pace pressure
scenarios.body: The increased gallop stretches the field and sets up the race for a strong closer to pick up the pieces. Ghost Jury and Inca get the pace they need to unleash finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl
scenarios.trigger: If all prominent runners sit and wait creating a slow-motion affair
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle with positioning crucial at the business end. Hold-up horses struggle in the resultant dash while Beorma's class tells.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Leader Dominates Solo
scenarios.trigger: If This Sway gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The prominent style horse gets such an easy time in front that he builds an unassailable advantage. Late closers never get within striking distance despite their finishing efforts.

watchPoints.text: Ghost Jury's 224-day layoff could see her fitness desert her when the race heats up from three out
Beorma running again after just 5 days may show signs of her recent chasing exertions
Tiggerelli's market support will indicate if connections expect improvement under new trainer Ewan Whillans
Klervia's wind operation effects become apparent if she fails to maintain her prominent position
This Sway's jumping under pressure as he hasn't led from the front in his recent hurdles runs
